title: Accounts clerk back from leave: Teams rejects her password
scenario: A returning user's password expired during her leave. The error code she quotes looks like the sign-in codes in this domain but belongs to invalid credentials; a self-service reset fixes it and nothing else is involved.

events.title: cant log in to teams after holiday
events.text:
Hi IT. Back from two weeks off and Teams says my password is wrong. I'm sure I typed it right. Tried four times and now I'm scared of locking myself out. There's a code in small grey letters, AADSTS50126, if that means anything. Please help, I have the month-end report due.

Esme Fairweather (Accounts)

events.title: Re: cant log in to teams after holiday
events.text:
Hi Esme, no harm done, four tries is under the lockout limit. That message usually means the password has expired rather than been mistyped: passwords here expire after 90 days and yours ran out while you were away. Please open the self-service reset page (link below), choose a new password and then sign in to Teams again. If the reset page refuses you, ring the helpdesk on the number below and we will do it together.

Imogen

events.title: Re: cant log in to teams after holiday
events.text: That worked, thank you! It also made me register a phone number for the reset thing, which I did. Teams is open and my chats are all there.

events.title: Re: cant log in to teams after holiday
events.text:
Lovely. Heads-up: the new password also applies to Outlook on your phone and the VPN, so you may be asked for it again there today. Nothing else needed from you.

Imogen

events.title: Case closed
events.text: Status changed from Resolved to Closed after 24 hours without a reply.
